biotools.summary: MITE is a database storing information on tailoring enzymes involved in specialized metabolite biosynthesis. It provides detailed annotation of enzyme reactions, substrate specificities, and known substrate-product pairs, and can be used for machine learning, synthetic biology, and knowledge base applications.
